en.askTitle: Put in your own city, recipes, costs and market terms and get the same Texas home-bakery plan
en.runTitle: San Antonio: a nurse plans a home bakery for March 2027 on a $3,000 budget

fields.label: Physical home address or DSHS registration ID
fields.placeholder: e.g. your DSHS registration ID in place of a home address

fields.label: Allergens to replace
fields.placeholder: e.g. wheat, milk, eggs, soy, plus tree nuts if present

fields.label: Recipes and shelf-stability evidence
fields.placeholder: e.g. a sourdough loaf and cookie recipe, with how long each keeps

fields.label: Actual ingredient and packaging costs
fields.placeholder: e.g. last month’s flour, butter, boxes and labels, with what you paid

fields.label: Timed batch yields
fields.placeholder: e.g. 24 cookies per batch in 90 minutes

fields.label: Available hours
fields.placeholder: e.g. 10 hours a week around night shifts

fields.label: Prices and order mix
fields.value: Cakes, cookies and sourdough, about 15–20 orders a month at first

fields.label: Target hourly pay
fields.value: At least $15 an hour after ingredients, packaging, market fees and payment fees

fields.label: Market’s written admission and attendance terms
fields.placeholder: e.g. the market’s vendor page with booth fee and application dates

en.template:
{address}
Contains: wheat, milk, eggs, soy {allergens}. Build a preorder-first Texas home-bakery plan for {city}, using {recipes}, {costs}, {yields}, {hours} and {cash}. Compare {prices} with {pay} after all work and fees. Separate food rules, sales-tax/DBA questions and {market}. Show the no-market alternative and missing launch checks. Ask before contacting anyone, filing, paying or sharing my details.

phases.title: Check the current Texas, San Antonio, tax and market rules against official pages
phases.note: Home-food law, sales-tax permit, business-name registration and market vendor terms
phases.judgment: It kept an inconvenient finding in the plan: the Saturday market it checked excludes home-food sellers, and two official pages disagree on the business-name filing fee, so that fee is left as unsettled rather than averaged.

phases.title: Build the guide, the start-up budget and a pricing model that counts her own labour
phases.note: Per-product prices with the arithmetic shown
phases.judgment: The pricing result was not softened: with explicit assumptions, preorders of shelf-stable items work (cakes $80, cookie dozens $33, loaves $25), but weekly markets miss her $15-an-hour target.

phases.title: Independent audit of the rules and arithmetic, plus desktop and phone layout
phases.judgment: The independent check caught real mistakes: all twelve monthly hourly-pay cells were wrong (for example $400.23 an hour instead of $17.79). They were corrected and the check passed on a re-run.

workers: Checked state sales-tax rules, county business-name registration and the vendor terms of a Saturday market
Read the current Texas home-food law and the state health department’s guidance, and checked what city rules and private restrictions can stop
Independently recomputed every money figure and checked each rule claim against the source list
